text:
Sylvie Chen: Hi folks — opened PR #482 to update the Quickstart README with an M1 install note and a clearer cURL example. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :wave:
Aj Patel: looking now, thanks. quick Q — did you test the cURL example on mac? the headers look fine but macs sometimes need different flags.
Sylvie Chen: tested on Intel + M1 in a container, but not on bare mac. I added a short note: "on macOS, use --network=host for Linux containers or use the CLI binary." not sure if wording is ok.
Kevin B: nit: line 48 has a stray backtick in the bash snippet. otherwise LGTM. also suggest adding a one-liner for the SDK JS snippet.
Sylvie Chen: good catch, thanks. I'll remove the backtick and add the JS snippet. Proposed snippet:

```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-redwood', prompt: 'Hello' });
```

Any objections to keeping both cURL + SDK examples?
Maria Gomez: both is 👍. maybe shorten the JS to a minimal example and link to SDK docs for more details.
Aj Patel: LGTM after the backtick fix. can you also add a changelog entry? We auto-generate release notes from CHANGELOG.md
Sylvie Chen: will add changelog line and push fixes in a minute. @docbot can you run link-checker once CI passes? :robot_face:
docbot: link-checker queued for PR #482 — I'll post results here when done.
Kevin B: once CI is green and docbot confirms, feel free to merge. no need to wait for another reviewer unless you want extra eyes.
Sylvie Chen: great—pushed fixes. thanks all! :tada:
